name: heXentafl
author: Kevin R. Kane
description: heXentafl, Kevin R. Kane's hexagonal Hnefatafl (nestorgames, 2020). Asymmetric siege on a hexhex board: the King sits on the central throne with three defenders (seat 0, moving first) against six attackers on the six corners. Everything but the 4x4 King slides like a rook along the three hex lines; the King steps one space. A man is captured by being sandwiched on opposite sides, a man on a corner by the two rim cells flanking it, and the King on his throne only by three attackers on three non-adjacent sides. The defenders win by escorting the King to any corner, the attackers by taking him. A 5x5 option adds six more attackers, three more defenders and a rook-moving King.
